_about: KS3 instrument kinds that the lesson-page answer capture (shared/mrbadmus.v2.js) did not handle on 25 Oct 2026, each classified from its shared/ks3.js wire function and its markup. shape: G commit-before-explore gate, A/M immediate choice units, S several placements committed together, T typed/selected inputs committed by a button, X exploration only, R reading only, D drag/canvas. Read by tools/activity_save_coverage.py.

ks3-ab-block.verdict: none — five environment tabs [data-ab-env] (aria-pressed) un-hide [data-ab-envpanel]; count is tabs seen
ks3-ab-block.notes: The tabs carry class ks3-option, so this kind must NOT be added to KIND_A or every tab press would be captured as an answer.

ks3-abench-block.verdict: not judged — the pressed gopt gets aria-pressed=true, the gate [data-abench-gate] is hidden and [data-abench-bench] opens; nothing ever says which calculation was right and there is no data-correct
ks3-abench-block.restore: click the same [data-abench-gopt] (the handler runs even though the gate is hidden)
ks3-abench-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (gopt suffix, whole block = one unit, sent self_checked); the appliance, preset and slider bench after it is exploration.

ks3-ahist-block.verdict: none — a single stepper button [data-ahist-reveal] un-hides [data-ahist-why] one step at a time, then [data-ahist-panel]

ks3-alt-block.verdict: not judged — aria-pressed on the gopt, [data-alt-gate] hidden, [data-alt-body] opens; the note [data-alt-note] describes the physics without referring back to the pick
ks3-alt-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (gopt); the height and case seg buttons after it are exploration.

ks3-amgrid-block.unit: [data-amgrid-cell][aria-pressed="true"] (the selected tube; the three predict buttons are SHARED by all 8 cells, not nested in them)
ks3-amgrid-block.verdict: not judged — the first predict press per cell is final (later presses are ignored, buttons c3Enable'd off), the pick keeps aria-pressed=true while that cell is selected, [data-amgrid-result=<cell>] is un-hidden (.ks3-amgrid-verdict text) and the cell's [data-amgrid-mark] (fizzes/none) is shown; there is no answer key for fast/slow/none
ks3-amgrid-block.restore: for each cell: click [data-amgrid-cell="<metal:acid>"], then click [data-amgrid-predict="<value>"]
ks3-amgrid-block.notes: Adding `predict` to the option suffixes is not enough: the unit is page state (the pressed cell), so the unit has to be the data-amgrid-cell value pressed at commit time; it is the same pattern as ks3-catb-block.

ks3-ba-block.verdict: none — chemical tabs .ks3-ba-tab plus a step button [data-ba-up] and a reset [data-ba-reset]; [data-ba-verdict] is composed text about the model, not about the child
ks3-ba-block.notes: The tabs carry class ks3-option, so keep this kind out of KIND_A.

ks3-bal-block.verdict: not judged — aria-pressed=true on the pick, [data-benchgate] hidden, [data-benchbody] (the .ks3-bal bench) un-hidden; no data-correct
ks3-bal-block.wire: wireBalanceBench @21021 (gate: wireBenchGate @19748, called at its end)
ks3-bal-block.notes:
Fits adapter A as-is through the .ks3-option class (no data-

-opt; the value is data-i); the reaction, vessel and run controls are .ks3-sim-seg-btn exploration; wireBenchGate is shared by many C2 benches.

ks3-bb-block.verdict: none — field tabs [data-bb-field] and a run button [data-bb-run] un-hide that field's [data-bb-verdict]
ks3-bb-block.notes: The tabs carry class ks3-option, so keep this kind out of KIND_A.

ks3-bbench-block.unit: the dial combination: the [data-bbench-val] of the pressed [data-bbench-for="reaction"] and [data-bbench-for="vessel"] buttons joined with ':' (4 runs)
ks3-bbench-block.verdict: not judged — the prediction gates the Run button; Run un-hides [data-bbench-panel="<reaction>:<vessel>"] (tiles + .ks3-bbench-note); changing a dial withdraws the prediction (all aria-pressed=false)
ks3-bbench-block.restore: for each run: click the dial buttons for that combination, click the predicted .ks3-option (data-i), then click [data-bbench-run]
ks3-bbench-block.notes: Adapter A as-is would fold all four runs into one whole-block unit, so the unit has to be keyed on the dial state at commit time.

ks3-becomes-block.verdict: none — row toggles [data-cmp-open] un-hide [data-cmp-why]; the before/after values are visible from the start
ks3-becomes-block.notes: A reveal table: the block marker is data-cmpblock, not data-becomes.

ks3-bell-block.verdict: none — a range slider [data-bell-slider] and two presets .ks3-bell-preset[data-preset] drive the readouts and the chain

ks3-bench-block.verdict: none — cell tabs .ks3-bench-cell[data-cell] un-hide the matching figure and panel

ks3-bill-block.verdict: not judged — aria-pressed on the gopt, [data-bill-gate] hidden, [data-bill-panel] opens; no data-correct and no verdict about the pick
ks3-bill-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (gopt); the five sliders after it are exploration.

ks3-btally-block.verdict: not judged — aria-pressed on the gopt, [data-btally-gate] hidden, [data-btally-bench] opens; the [data-btally-note] text appears only when the slider is near the real value, which is exploration and not a verdict on the gopt
ks3-btally-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (gopt); the device tabs and the slider are exploration.

ks3-budget-block.unit: .ks3-sample[data-sample] (a panel, s1–s6; the tabs .ks3-sample-tab[data-sample] only switch panels)
ks3-budget-block.verdict: not marked on the controls — the first verdict per sample is final (both buttons disabled after), the pick gets aria-pressed=true and that sample's [data-verdict-panel] is un-hidden; .ks3-verdict-name names the sample and whether it is an element (e.g. 'Water — not an element.'), so right/wrong can only be read from that text
ks3-budget-block.restore: for each decided sample: click its .ks3-sample-tab, then click .ks3-verdict-btn[data-verdict=yes|no] inside that panel (no tests need re-running, because the verdict handler does not check the budget)
ks3-budget-block.notes: The attributes have no prefix (data-verdict, data-sample), so OPT_RE and UNIT_RE miss them; the test buttons .ks3-test-btn[data-test] spend a global budget of 8 and are exploration evidence, not answers.

ks3-burner-block.verdict: not judged — the prediction un-hides [data-burner-panel="<fuel>:<air>"] (tiles + .ks3-burner-note) and it stays changeable (a repick re-presses); no data-correct
ks3-burner-block.notes: There is one prediction for the whole block (it is not withdrawn on a dial change, unlike bbench), so adapter A as-is works with the whole block as the unit; the fuel and air dials are exploration.

ks3-calor-block.verdict: not judged — aria-pressed on the gopt, [data-calor-gate] hidden, [data-calor-bench] opens
ks3-calor-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (gopt); the burn, fresh and record buttons and the mass slider are exploration (recorded runs land in [data-calor-rows]).

ks3-catb-block.unit: [data-catb-tab][aria-pressed="true"] (the selected flask t1–t5; the three predict buttons are shared, not nested)
ks3-catb-block.verdict: not judged — the first prediction per flask is final (buttons c3Enable'd off), it stays aria-pressed=true while that flask is selected, and [data-catb-result=<tab>] is un-hidden (.ks3-catb-verdict + .ks3-catb-why); no answer key
ks3-catb-block.restore: for each flask: click [data-catb-tab="tN"], then click [data-catb-predict="fast|same|slow"]
ks3-catb-block.notes: Same machine as ks3-amgrid-block: the unit is the selected tab at commit time, not an ancestor.

ks3-cbal-block.verdict: live and judged against cfg.eqs[].target — [data-cbal-balanced] un-hides when the counts match; [data-cbal-note=target] for the smallest numbers vs [data-cbal-note=multiple] for a multiple; [data-cbal-tick=<id>] un-hides only once the target is reached; each [data-cbal-counter] carries data-cbal-match=1|0
ks3-cbal-block.restore: for each equation: click its [data-cbal-tab], then click that block's [data-cbal-for=i][data-cbal-delta=1] (value−1) times per term (coefficients start at 1)
ks3-cbal-block.notes: There is no Check button: the answer is the coefficient tuple read from [data-cbal-coeff] text, so a capture should fire when [data-cbal-balanced] opens (or on the tick) rather than on every press.

ks3-cband-block.wire: none — deliberately unwired (comment at shared/ks3.js 37598); ticked by its sibling bench through markSibling
ks3-cband-block.notes: All six instances (electric-circuits pages) have 0 buttons and 0 inputs: a fixed fault table.

ks3-cbeam-block.verdict: none — four split buttons [data-cbeam-split] redraw the pan and un-hide [data-cbeam-note]

ks3-cbench-block.verdict: none — material tabs [data-cbench-mat], a run [data-cbench-run] and an electrons toggle [data-cbench-elec]

ks3-ccheck-block.unit: the claim selected by [data-pick][aria-pressed="true"] (c1–c5; the fault buttons are shared, not nested)
ks3-ccheck-block.verdict: judged: Check un-hides .ks3-ccheck-verdict[data-verdict=<claim>], which carries data-answer=<fault>; inside it [data-word="right"] ('That is the fault') or [data-word="wrong"] ('Not the main fault here') is un-hidden; the fault buttons are then disabled
ks3-ccheck-block.restore: for each checked claim: click [data-pick="cN"], click .ks3-ccheck-fault[data-fault=<pick>], then click [data-ccheck-open]
ks3-ccheck-block.notes: Structurally this is B5C (pick a unit, choose, press Check, right/wrong from the reveal's data-answer), but its attribute names (data-pick, data-fault, data-ccheck-open) are not wireB5Commit's.

ks3-cd-block.verdict: none — cell tabs .ks3-cd-tab and a one-shot 'Cut off the oxygen' [data-cd-cut] per panel un-hide [data-cd-fails]
ks3-cd-block.notes: The tabs carry class ks3-option, so keep this kind out of KIND_A.

ks3-chband-block.wire: none — deliberately unwired (comment at shared/ks3.js 37608, 'MUST NOT GAIN ONE'); ticked by the sibling bench through markSibling
ks3-chband-block.notes: All three instances (static-electricity pages) have 0 buttons and 0 inputs: a fixed triboelectric ladder.

ks3-chroma-block.verdict: judged in text only — one-shot (the pens disable after a pick); [data-chroma-say=<pen>] is un-hidden, whose .ks3-chroma-saytitle starts 'Pen A. …' when right and 'Pen A is the match — look again …' when wrong; the key is cfg.match ('a') in the JSON data-cfg on [data-chroma], not an attribute adapter A reads
ks3-chroma-block.restore: set the three dials to their no-fault values (data-chroma-fault=""), click [data-chroma-run], then click the same [data-chroma-pen]
ks3-chroma-block.notes: Widening: add `pen` to the option suffixes. Even then, right/wrong is only in cfg.match, and the reveal is a -say element that SHOWN_RE misses, so it would be sent self_checked with no text unless `say` is also added; the pen question only appears after a clean run, so the dials and run are exploration.

ks3-chthink.notes: Ticked by the xfer bench beside it through markSibling.

ks3-clamp-block.verdict: not judged — aria-pressed on the gopt, [data-clamp-gate] hidden, [data-clamp-body] opens
ks3-clamp-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (gopt); gateP7 is the shared P7 gate helper, so the other P7 benches using it share this shape.

ks3-clock-block.verdict: none — add-drink [data-add], remedy toggles [data-fix] (each only shows its [data-fixnote]), wait [data-clock-wait] and reset [data-clock-reset]; [data-clock-verdict] describes the clock, not a choice
ks3-clock-block.notes: The remedy picks look like options, but the model ignores them and nothing judges them.

ks3-cloop-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; gate [data-cloop-gate] hides and [data-cloop-body] un-hides; the bench notes (p8Note) depend on cells/switch/slot, never on the prediction
ks3-cloop-block.restore: click the same [data-cloop-gopt] button (gate is still visible on a fresh page)
ks3-cloop-block.notes: Buttons are .ks3-option + data-cloop-gopt, so adding the kind to KIND_A as-is would capture it whole-block self_checked; the bench controls after it (cells/sw/slot tabs) are exploration.

ks3-confront.wire: none (no selector for data-confront in shared/ks3.js)
ks3-confront.notes: All 54 data-confront sections scanned: none holds a button, input, select or textarea.

ks3-construct-block.verdict: not judged: [data-reveal] (.ks3-construct-out) un-hidden showing Riya's model lines (.ks3-model-line); child then self-ticks [data-crit] checkboxes and [data-construct-tally] shows when all ticked
ks3-construct-block.restore: type values into the four [data-fifa-input] inputs (fire input), then click [data-construct-check]; optionally re-tick [data-crit]
ks3-construct-block.notes: Same F-I-F-A shape as the captured data-p<N>cfa calculations but no calcOf marking hook; the section also carries a separate [data-criteria-btn] 'Check your answer' + [data-criteria] list.

ks3-counter-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-benchgate] hidden, [data-benchbody] (.ks3-counter) un-hidden; later notes depend on the temp/vol/count controls only
ks3-counter-block.notes: Gate options carry only .ks3-option + data-i (no prefixed opt attr), so adapter A's class test would catch them whole-block; the .ks3-counter-btn groups and bumps toggle are exploration.

ks3-critique.verdict: each li.ks3-step carries data-fault="1" (should be flagged) or "0"; right = (button aria-pressed=="true") === (data-fault=="1"); the check unhides every [data-reveal] whose .ks3-step-word reads "Costs him" or "Sound" — no class or attribute is set on the step
ks3-critique.restore: toggle each .ks3-step-btn to its saved aria-pressed state, then click [data-steps-reveal] (enabled once at least one is pressed)
ks3-critique.notes: Class is ks3-critique (no -block), so KIND_A's "ks3-critique-block" never matches it; buttons stay toggleable after the reveal.

ks3-cross-block.verdict: none: two toggles [data-switch] (breathing, blood_flow) swap which .ks3-cross-note[data-state] is shown
ks3-cross-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore beyond toggling [data-switch]
ks3-cross-block.notes: One switch press ticks the stage; nothing asked or judged.

ks3-cryst-block.unit: the current setting = pressed [data-cryst-for=solute] + [data-cryst-for=method] buttons (not a DOM ancestor)
ks3-cryst-block.verdict: not judged: prediction only unlocks [data-cryst-run]; Run un-hides [data-cryst-panel] with the method's own note in [data-cryst-verdict]/[data-cryst-hazard], never compared to the pick
ks3-cryst-block.restore: click the solute and method [data-cryst-val] buttons, click the same gate .ks3-option, then click [data-cryst-run]
ks3-cryst-block.notes: The prediction re-arms on every dial change (aria-pressed cleared), so one block yields one prediction per solute:method run, keyed by the dials, not by an ancestor unit.

ks3-cthink-block.wire: none (no wire function; ks3.js @37598 says data-cthinkblock is deliberately unwired, ticked by the sibling cloop bench via markSibling)
ks3-cthink-block.notes: 'Think again' text-only block; its stage tick comes from wireCircuitLoop's data-sibling='s-think'.

ks3-cundt-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-cundt-gate] hidden, [data-cundt-body] shown; readouts depend on component tab + supply slider only
ks3-cundt-block.notes: Same p8Gate shape as cloop; .ks3-option + gopt means KIND_A as-is would capture it whole-block self_checked.

ks3-cut-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-benchgate] hidden, [data-benchbody] (.ks3-cut) shown; the cut/undo buttons drive the readouts
ks3-cut-block.notes: Gate options are .ks3-option + data-i only; the .ks3-cut-btn cut/undo buttons are exploration.

ks3-cy-block.verdict: none: run buttons [data-cy-year], [data-cy-ten], [data-cy-cull], [data-cy-reset] advance a predator-prey model
ks3-cy-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-cy-block.notes: Stage ticks once ten years have been run; nothing is judged.

ks3-dh-block.unit: one dial = buttons sharing data-dh-dial (strands | bases | pairing)
ks3-dh-block.verdict: live, no Check: each [data-dh-card] gets/loses attribute data-pass and shows [data-dh-tag=pass|fail]; [data-dh-verdicttag] text ('Every test passed' / '{n} tests still failing'); solved when every dial equals the wrap's data-target JSON, e.g. {"bases":"in","pairing":"specific","strands":"2"}
ks3-dh-block.restore: click, per dial, the .ks3-dh-opt whose data-dh-dial/data-dh-opt match the stored model
ks3-dh-block.notes: The buttons DO match OPT_RE (data-dh-opt) and .ks3-option, but the unit is on the button (data-dh-dial), not an ancestor, so KIND_A as-is would merge three dials into one unit; the opening state is preset pressed (Pauling's wrong model) and is not the child's answer.

ks3-dial-block.verdict: none: cycle-length chips [data-dial-len], day slider [data-dial-day], step buttons [data-dial-prev]/[data-dial-next] change the readouts
ks3-dial-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-dial-block.notes: Stage ticks after data-credit (2) lengths tried; nothing asked.

ks3-dipc-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-dipc-gate] hidden, [data-dipc-body] shown; notes depend on latitude slider and near/mount tabs
ks3-dipc-block.notes: p10Gate is a byte-for-byte twin of p8Gate; .ks3-option + gopt fits KIND_A as-is (whole block, self_checked).

ks3-dlab-block.verdict: none: four dials [data-dlab-for][data-dlab-val] (solute, temp, stir, powder) change the beaker readouts
ks3-dlab-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-dlab-block.notes: The bench is hidden until the SEPARATE sibling activity named in data-dlab-lock ('gate-which-dial') is answered; that gate is its own block and kind, not part of this one.

ks3-dlane-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-dlane-gate] hidden, [data-dlane-body] shown; notes depend on surface/mass tabs
ks3-dlane-block.wire: wireDragLane @10024 (inline gate, same shape as p8Gate)
ks3-dlane-block.notes: Fits KIND_A as-is via .ks3-option/gopt; the surface and mass tabs after it are exploration.

ks3-dprobe-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-dprobe-gate] hidden, [data-dprobe-body] shown; readouts depend on liquid tabs and depth slider

ks3-ebench-block.verdict: case's data-ok ('1'/'0') compared with the pressed button's data-call; first press latched into data-called on the case; [data-reveal] (.ks3-ebench-verdict) un-hidden with .ks3-ebench-vlabel text; after all 7, [data-ebench-tally] shows 'you called {n}'
ks3-ebench-block.restore: click the .ks3-ebench-btn with the same data-call in the n-th .ks3-ebench-case
ks3-ebench-block.notes: Judgeable from markup alone but the unit attr is bare data-case and the option attr bare data-call, so UNIT_RE/OPT_RE miss both; the button stays changeable but the latched first call is what the tally counts.

ks3-echo-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-echo-gate] hidden, [data-echo-body] shown; readouts depend on distance slider and surface tabs

ks3-elay-block.verdict: none: tapping a layer [data-elay-layer] shows its [data-elay-out] fact panel
ks3-elay-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-elay-block.notes: Tabs/reveal; stage ticks once all 4 layers opened.

ks3-eqb-block.verdict: [data-eqb-checkpanel=<case>] un-hidden with exactly one [data-eqb-branch] shown: 'perfect' (right) or 'distractor' | 'side' | 'missing' (wrong), plus [data-eqb-why=<name>] for a distractor
ks3-eqb-block.restore: click [data-eqb-tab=<case>], click each row's [data-eqb-place] matching the stored placement, then click [data-eqb-check]
ks3-eqb-block.notes: Placement read from aria-pressed=true on each row's place button (data-eqb-row holds the substance name); moving any chip re-hides the verdict, so read it right after Check.

ks3-erun-block.verdict: none: enzyme tabs .ks3-erun-enzyme, pH tabs .ks3-erun-ph, temperature slider [data-temp] and a run button
ks3-erun-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-erun-block.notes: Stage ticks on the first run; the [data-verdict] shown after a run describes the outcome, not a judgement of the child.

ks3-fall-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-fall-gate] hidden, [data-fall-bench] shown; arrows depend on object tabs and speed slider
ks3-fall-block.notes: The body is [data-fall-bench], not -body; still fits KIND_A as-is via .ks3-option/gopt.

ks3-fband-block.wire: none (no wire function; ticked by the sibling bench via markSibling)
ks3-fband-block.notes: All 5 instances (forces unit pages) contain 0 buttons and 0 inputs.

ks3-fgauge-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-fgauge-gate] hidden, [data-fgauge-body] shown; readouts depend on material tabs and depth slider

ks3-fgrid-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed only; [data-fgrid-gate] hidden, [data-fgrid-body] shown; field readouts depend on setup tabs and position slider
ks3-fgrid-block.notes: p9Gate is the same shape as p8Gate; fits KIND_A as-is.

ks3-fit-block.verdict: [data-reveal] (.ks3-fit-out) un-hidden; [data-fit-badge] gets data-state works (right) | waste (all needed parts plus extras) | fails (a part missing), with headline in [data-fit-verdict] and per-part [data-fit-findings] li[data-kind=missing|extra]
ks3-fit-block.restore: click .ks3-fit-tab[data-fit=<id>], toggle each stored .ks3-fit-part[data-part] to aria-pressed=true, then click [data-fit-run]
ks3-fit-block.notes: The parts are rebuilt by JS on every tab change and come from the cell-bench payload named by spec.parts_from, so the placed set is only readable from aria-pressed on the rebuilt buttons of the current tab.

ks3-fm-block.verdict: none: four dials .ks3-fm-opt[data-dial][data-opt] and presets [data-fm-preset] select which [data-fm-branch] outcome panel shows
ks3-fm-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-fm-block.notes: Dial buttons carry .ks3-option, so adding this kind to KIND_A would wrongly record exploration as answers.

ks3-fold-block.verdict: none: three toggles [data-fold-toggle] add surface levels and update the area readout
ks3-fold-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-fold-block.notes: Stage ticks when all 3 levels are on.

ks3-forbid-block.verdict: none: two buttons [data-forbid-move=small|big] each reveal [data-forbid-reveal] with that move's product and text; both stay available
ks3-forbid-block.restore: cannot be an answer; nothing to restore
ks3-forbid-block.notes: By design a show-both comparison (the code says neither button is spent), not a choice that is judged.

ks3-fsort-block.unit: the selected situation tab [data-fsort-tab=<i>] (one shared label set; no ancestor unit)
ks3-fsort-block.verdict: pressed label's data-fsort-label compared with hidden [data-fsort-data=<i>]'s data-answer; [data-fsort-verdict] un-hidden with [data-fsort-out=yours] vs [data-fsort-out=true] (data-answer-label); labels lock (disabled) after the first pick
ks3-fsort-block.restore: click [data-fsort-tab=<i>] then the .ks3-fsort-label with the stored data-fsort-label
ks3-fsort-block.notes: Eight items share one set of 4 label buttons, so the unit is the pressed tab's index at click time, not any DOM ancestor; the answer is on the page in data-answer.

ks3-ftank-block.verdict: not judged: gate hidden, bench un-hidden, aria-pressed on the chosen option only; no data-correct or verdict element anywhere in the block
ks3-ftank-block.restore: click the same option once on a fresh page (gate is visible until the first commit)
ks3-ftank-block.notes: Adapter A already reads data-ftank-gopt (+ .ks3-option class), so adding the kind to KIND_A captures it self_checked; the bench's block-picker buttons also carry class `ks3-ftank-block`, identical to the section's kind class, so never select the block by that class.

ks3-gap-block.verdict: no mark on the option; the choice equal to data-empty-choice on [data-gap] ("3") un-hides [data-note="empty"] ('…the only one that survives'), any other un-hides [data-note="filled"]; aria-pressed on the chosen option
ks3-gap-block.restore: click the same data-i option (choice stays changeable; the rig un-hides on the first pick)
ks3-gap-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is through the .ks3-option class (unit = whole block, value data-i, stored self_checked with the visible data-note text); ONE widening judges it: read data-empty-choice on [data-gap] as the right data-i. The three test buttons after it are exploration.

ks3-gas-block.verdict: after the check each row gets data-verdict="right"|"wrong" (key = row's data-change); count span [data-gas-count] reads '{n} of 4 predicted correctly'; choices disabled
ks3-gas-block.restore: click .ks3-gas-choice[data-choice=X] in each row, then click [data-gas-open] (enabled only when all 4 rows are picked)
ks3-gas-block.notes: Picks are changeable until the check; the answer key sits in markup as data-change on each row before the check, and inner buttons also carry data-gas=<id> so `[data-gas]` matches both the wrap and every button.

ks3-gcmp-block.verdict: none: reveal toggles ([data-cmp-open] buttons show/hide each row's [data-cmp-why])
ks3-gcmp-block.restore: cannot / not needed: nothing is answered
ks3-gcmp-block.notes: Wired by the shared data-cmpblock attribute (not a gcmp-specific selector); row divs carry data-cmp-row, which matches adapter A's UNIT_RE, but there are no option buttons.

ks3-ghouse-block.verdict: none: one reveal button ([data-ghouse-reveal]) opens the four steps in order, then the panel

ks3-scards-block.notes: Three static cards and a closing paragraph; no controls and no rail stop.

ks3-scope-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed, gate hidden, [data-scope-body] shown; the data-scope-out=verdict tile is 'what you would hear', not about the prediction

ks3-settles.check: [data-settle-reveal] inside each panel (enabled when all its features are marked)
ks3-settles.verdict: each li.ks3-feature carries data-settles="1"|"0"; right = (pressed data-pick=="yes") === (data-settles=="1"); the check disables the choices, unhides each [data-reveal] (.ks3-why-word "Settles it."/"Settles nothing.") and [data-case-verdict]
ks3-settles.restore: per panel: click each feature's saved .ks3-settle-choice, then that panel's [data-settle-reveal]; then the [data-selfcheck] .ks3-option
ks3-settles.notes: After all four cases open, [data-selfcheck] shows a self-rating .ks3-option question (data-i, not judged); the feature li reuse of data-settles also makes the dispatcher call wireSettles on every li, harmlessly.

ks3-shell-block.verdict: none: four [data-shel-toggle] rows reveal [data-shel-detail]; one-way open; counter 'n of 4 opened'
ks3-shell-block.notes: Marker is data-shelblock / data-shel (one 'l'); the code calls it a reference strip, and no commitment is taken.

ks3-slane-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed, gate hidden, [data-slane-body] shown
ks3-slane-block.notes: Bench is two sliders plus in-step/out-of-step [data-slane-step] toggles (exploration).

ks3-slink-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed, gate hidden, [data-slink-body] shown
ks3-slink-block.notes: Bench is [data-slink-drive] tabs plus a mark slider.

ks3-smatrix-block.verdict: none: a static table whose lit row follows the sbench block's data-squash/data-trails (ks3:statebench event)
ks3-smatrix-block.notes: No controls of its own and no data-stage-done; it only reads another block's state.

ks3-solen-block.verdict: not judged: p10Gate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-solen-gate], shows [data-solen-body]
ks3-solen-block.notes: Bench is two sliders plus core/switch .ks3-seg-btn rows.

ks3-sortcards-block.verdict: immediate: the card gets data-verdict=right|wrong, [data-note=right] or [data-note=wrong] is unhidden; key = data-answer on the card (compared with the button's data-choice)
ks3-sortcards-block.restore: click the same [data-choice] button in the n-th [data-card] card
ks3-sortcards-block.notes: Unprefixed data-card/data-choice miss UNIT_RE/OPT_RE, but adapter A's existing 'data-answer on the unit' rule would judge it once those two are recognised. It is deliberately re-answerable (not one-shot).

ks3-span-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed, gate hidden, [data-span-body] shown; the 'verdict' tile is Moves / Does not budge for the nut
ks3-span-block.notes: Bench is [data-span-arm] seg tabs plus a force slider.

ks3-spbench-block.verdict: not judged: p12Gate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-spbench-gate], shows [data-spbench-body]
ks3-spbench-block.notes: All six pages (p12 space unit) carry the gate; the six data-model variants share one wire, and the bench is tabs + slider.

ks3-specb-block.verdict: immediate on the second pick: [data-specb-out="job:mat"] is unhidden, carrying data-fit="1|0" and .ks3-specb-verdict 'That one fits.' / 'Not this one.'
ks3-specb-block.notes: A pick-a-job-then-a-material pair with no Check button; it is re-triable, credit counts on the first fit, and only the current pair's readout stays in the DOM. Like the B5C family but with no check.

ks3-splot-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed, gate hidden, [data-splot-body] shown
ks3-splot-block.notes: The bench (load slider plus Record / Clear / New spring) is an exploration; the stage needs commit plus 2 readings.

ks3-spthink.notes: All three have no controls; the wire only ticks the stop when the hook's or ladder rung 1's options are pressed.

ks3-srig-block.verdict: none: one [data-srig-reveal] button unhides each [data-srig-why] in turn

ks3-ss-block.verdict: none: [data-ss-toggle] (all↔none) and [data-ss-half] buttons change the shelf state and the two bars

ks3-still-block.verdict: not judged: aria-pressed on the pick, the predict panel hides and [data-still-body] opens; after the [data-still-next] stages a [data-still-result] panel shows the outcome, but it is never compared with the pick
ks3-still-block.restore: click [data-still-for=mixture][data-still-val=<mix>] (if not already that mix), then the same .ks3-option[data-i] in that mixture's predict panel
ks3-still-block.notes: One prediction per mixture, re-asked whenever the mixture dial changes, so adapter A needs one widening: add unit attr `predict` (data-still-predict) to UNIT_RE, or every prediction collapses to a single block unit. The dials are .ks3-seg-btn, so they are safe.

ks3-stock-block.verdict: none: [data-stock-item] tabs show one [data-stock-out] reference panel
ks3-stock-block.notes: A reference panel switcher; data-stock-item matches UNIT_RE but no option attribute exists, so nothing would be captured.

ks3-tempb-block.verdict: not judged: the press disables all three predicts (aria-pressed=true on the pick) and unhides [data-tempb-run]; the revealed .ks3-tempb-delta carries data-exo="1" on a rise and no data-exo on the one fall, but nothing compares it to the pick
ks3-tempb-block.restore: click the same [data-tempb-predict] in the n-th [data-tempb-card] (works while the card is hidden behind its tab)
ks3-tempb-block.notes: Widening: add `predict` to the option suffixes; data-tempb-card already matches the `card` unit attr. Answer is permanent per card (data-open=1 locks it); tabs [data-tempb-tab] are navigation, not answers.

ks3-tgap-block.verdict: nothing judges it: p8Gate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-tgap-gate] and unhides [data-tgap-body]; no correct-answer attribute anywhere
ks3-tgap-block.restore: click the same [data-tgap-gopt] (pressOpt on .ks3-option label works although the gate is then hidden)
ks3-tgap-block.notes: Already fits adapter A as-is (gopt + .ks3-option, whole-block unit) — only needs ks3-tgap-block in KIND_A; the bench after it (spec/len tabs) is exploration.

ks3-titr-block.verdict: none — Add 1/Add 5 drops and Start again only move the pH reading; closer opens when the curve passes 7
ks3-titr-block.notes: No prediction gate in this block.

ks3-tpair-block.verdict: nothing judges it: p10Gate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-tpair-gate], unhides [data-tpair-body]
ks3-tpair-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is once ks3-tpair-block is in KIND_A; object tabs [data-tpair-obj] and the gap slider are exploration.

ks3-tpl-block.verdict: none — light slider [data-tpl-slider] + preset buttons [data-preset] only switch which [data-verdict] branch text shows
ks3-tpl-block.notes: The [data-verdict] elements describe the plant's net gas exchange, not the child.

ks3-tread-block.verdict: none — pressing [data-tread-cell] unhides that element's [data-tread-out] readout
ks3-tread-block.notes: Reference table; its rail stop is ticked by the hook, no markStage here.

ks3-trough-block.verdict: not judged and NOT a gate: predicts only toggle aria-pressed; picking a metal [data-trough-metal] unhides its [data-trough-run] whether or not a prediction was made, and then resets every [data-trough-opt] to aria-pressed=false
ks3-trough-block.restore: cannot meaningfully: the prediction is wiped by the next metal press, so the page never shows a stored prediction against a result; clicking metals re-runs them
ks3-trough-block.notes: One shared predict row for three metals and the metal press IS the run, so which metal a prediction belongs to is only knowable as the next [data-trough-metal] pressed (data-trough-opt already matches OPT_RE, but a whole-block unit would mislabel it).

ks3-troute-block.verdict: none — scenario tabs [data-troute-sc] relight the lamps and show that scenario's [data-troute-note]
ks3-troute-block.notes: Stop ticks after every scenario has been viewed.

ks3-twoq-block.verdict: none — amount tabs [data-twoq-amt] and speed tabs [data-twoq-spd] recompute temperature and store readouts
ks3-twoq-block.notes: Closer opens once both axes have been moved.

ks3-vcards-block.verdict: not judged by any attribute: the pick gets aria-pressed=true, all the card's options get disabled, card data-open=1, its [data-reveal] (.ks3-vcard-why) un-hidden; on compounds.html the reveal opens with Mixture. (comparable to the option text), on chemical-symbols.html the answer is only in prose
ks3-vcards-block.restore: click the same .ks3-vcard-opt (by label) in the n-th .ks3-vcard
ks3-vcards-block.notes: Adapter A would need two widenings (option class .ks3-vcard-opt and bare unit attr data-vcard), so listed as M; one-shot per card.

ks3-vtap-block.verdict: nothing judges it: p8Gate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-vtap-gate], unhides [data-vtap-body]
ks3-vtap-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is once ks3-vtap-block is in KIND_A; battery/component/position tabs are exploration.

ks3-walk-block.verdict: nothing judges it: wireBenchGate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-benchgate], unhides [data-benchbody] (the [data-walk] bench)
ks3-walk-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is (.ks3-option, whole-block unit) once ks3-walk-block is in KIND_A; run/reset/trace/warm buttons are exploration.

ks3-wanat-block.verdict: none — tabs [data-wanat-tab] (crest/trough/amplitude/wavelength) mark the part on the wave and swap the note; same tab again clears
ks3-wanat-block.notes: A labelled-diagram viewer, not a which-is-which quiz.

ks3-wband-block.wire: none (no wire function; ticked by a sibling via markSibling)
ks3-wband-block.notes: All six blocks checked: figure + closing text, zero buttons/inputs.

ks3-xfer-block.verdict: nothing judges it: p9Gate sets aria-pressed, hides [data-xfer-gate], unhides [data-xfer-body]
ks3-xfer-block.notes: Fits adapter A as-is once ks3-xfer-block is in KIND_A; material tabs and rub slider are exploration.

ks3-xroute-block.commit: [data-xroute-method] (with an ore selected; an ore press after a method also commits)
ks3-xroute-block.unit: [data-xroute-ore] (the pressed ore tab = the delivery being answered)
ks3-xroute-block.verdict: the shown [data-xroute-out="<ore>:<method>"] carries data-works="1"|"0" and its .ks3-xroute-title reads "It works." / "It does nothing." etc.; no class or aria on the buttons
ks3-xroute-block.restore: click the ore tab then the method tab (both are no-ops if already pressed)
ks3-xroute-block.notes: Unlimited retries and several methods can work for one ore (silver: alone/carbon/electric), so every ore+method pairing is an attempt, and 'found' latches on the first data-works=1.

ks3-zb-block.verdict: none — Zoom in/Back out reveal levels; the say-it-back .ks3-zb-qtab buttons only choose which pre-written [data-zb-answer] is shown
ks3-zb-block.notes: The question tabs carry class .ks3-option, so adding this kind to KIND_A would wrongly log tab presses as answers.

ks3-zoom-block.verdict: none — range [data-zoom-range] and stop ticks .ks3-zoom-tick switch the drawn level and panel
ks3-zoom-block.notes: Stop ticks once all five levels are seen.
